defs.def: a restaurant where you choose and pay for your meal at a counter and carry it to a table. Cafeterias are often found in factories, colleges, hospitals, etc. 自助餐厅；自助食堂

ex.s: Somewhere in the building, there was also a library, a cafeteria, and a gym.
ex.t: 大楼里的某个地方还有一间图书馆、一个食堂和一间健身房。

ex.s: On a regular day， students at the school sometimes come up to him to say they're not feeling well or other times to tell him about something that happened at break． He knows most of the kids at the school， but can't name each one． Some of them make him know them． Like Faith， who often forgets her backpack in the cafeteria， and Lucy， who just wants a hug．
ex.t: 平常的一天，学校里的学生有时会走到他面前说他们不舒服，有时则会告诉他课间发生的事。他认识学校里大多数孩子，却叫不出每个人的名字。有些孩子让他记住了自己，比如常常把背包忘在食堂的Faith，还有只想拥抱一下的Lucy。

ex.s: While waiting outside the cafeteria, I received the following message from my friend: (picture 1) It took me a minute before I realised what it meant.
ex.t: 在食堂外等候时，我收到了朋友发来的如下信息：（图1）我过了一分钟才明白它的意思。

ex.s: EXAMPLE 1 When I set off for the cafeteria … 2 Before he went into the chocolate factory … 3 By the time I arrived at the “insect” party … … I had just finished my homework.
ex.t: 示例　1 当我出发去食堂时……　2 在他走进巧克力工厂之前……　3 到我到达“昆虫”派对时……　……我刚做完作业。

ex.s: We would meet in the school cafeteria to bounce ideas off each other, and would laugh and argue and laugh some more as we learnt to work together as a team.
ex.t: 我们会在学校食堂碰面，互相激发想法，边笑边争论、再接着笑，学着作为一个团队一起合作。
